comment: Population strata and their needs (GDD 5.1; CORE simplified: five strata at the start (stage 4F, ADR 0020: thinkers and leaders added), later eras add more). gathers: the stratum works the land (only producers in eras 1-2). fights (optional): the stratum widens the influence zone (GDD 5.4). targetShare: share of the population this stratum drifts towards, in percent; the shares must add up to 100. needs: amounts per person per year. 'category' means any good of that storage class (food = any food, eaten most perishable first); 'good' means one good. basic needs decide hunger and health, higher needs raise mood. crafts (optional, stage 3e): the stratum works the settlement's recipe. sciencePerThousandPerYear (stage 3f): research points a thousand people of the stratum add per year. Stage 4F (ADR 0020): science comes mostly from thinkers; the shares keep Patryk's ratio thinker 30 : artisan 5 : others 1, times 2, so that a civilization of the usual mix researches about as fast as before (4.1 points per thousand people a year, was 4.2). Thinkers are the elders who keep and pass on what the people know (no priests: the game has no religion); leaders are the chief and the elders who decide (governments come with stage 4f).
